name: Piramal Finance Limited
remarksWeb: 1. There are several cases where shareholders are holding shares in multiple folios, the same have been clubbed based on common PAN in this shareholding pattern.  2. Out of the total holding, 155 shares are held by Mr. Ajay Piramal in the capacity of an administrator to the Estate of Late Mr. K S Basu and not in his personal capacity. 3. Shrikrishna Services Private Limited has become a wholly owned subsidiary of PDL Realty Private Limited and a part of promoter group with effect from 22nd April, 2026 4. AnsaPack (FC) Private Limited has become a subsidiary of Piramal Retail Private Limited and a part of promoter group with effect from 30th June, 2026 5. Consequent to Ansapack (FC) Private Limited becoming a subsidiary of Piramal Retail Private Limited, its subsidiary Rich Printer Private Limited became part of promoter group with effect from 30th June, 2026 6. Consequent to Ansapack (FC) Private Limited becoming a subsidiary of Piramal Retail Private Limited, its subsidiary Webteck Printpack Private Limited became part of promoter group with effect from 30th June, 2026 7. The Employee Benefit Trusts have sold 3550 shares on behalf of employees in the market on 30th June 2026 pursuant to exercise of ESOPs, however settlement of the same was carried out on T+1 days. Hence, 3550 shares were reflecting in the beneficiary position of the Employee Benefit Trusts on 30th June 2026.
